order: Fix every finding from the prior review round in full. Replace the copy-pasted runner semantics in the research seat's brief with the execution tool's real behavior: live working tree, no sandbox pinning, no automatic retries, one call per order, with unavailability escalated to the coordinating role. Make the reconciliation between the write-capable runner and the read-only plan explicit and mechanical across the research, analysis, and archiving briefs — every order must carry the read-only constraint in its text and pass the forbid parameter, described accurately as a brief-level prohibition rather than a sandboxed block. Rewrite the earlier incident narrative to the evidence-supported account rather than the unsupported claim, and correct two exercise reports whose dispatch-time details were dropped or wrong. Also clear the minor findings: stale status rows, a wrong tool count, an unjustified omission, an unexplained repeated log line, and a misattributed casting rule.
claims: We resolved all four major findings and the follow-on minors from the prior round across ten files (169 insertions, 46 deletions): the runner-semantics rewrite, the read-only reconciliation across three briefs, the incident-narrative rewrite, and two corrected exercise reports. The tool count was fixed to the actual four registered tools, and the casting rule's binding target was clarified. Each change was checked against the source file it corrects.
